skill.name: code-to-music
skill.description: Create instrumental music by composing MIDI with Python, rendering MP3 files, and validating audio quality with included utilities.
skill.summary: Create instrumental MP3 music with Python MIDI composition, FluidSynth rendering, and audio validation.
skill.author: Cam10001110101

security_audit.summary: Most static findings are false positives caused by Markdown code formatting, MIDI terminology, public reference links, and music examples. The confirmed risks are the system-modifying installer workflow and renderer cleanup that deletes temporary files derived from user output paths.

remediation.issue: Installer changes the host environment with apt-get and pip.
remediation.suggestion: Require explicit user confirmation, document required privileges, and prefer an isolated environment or container.

remediation.issue: Python dependencies use lower-bound version ranges only.
remediation.suggestion: Pin dependency versions or provide a lock file so installs are reproducible and easier to audit.

remediation.issue: Renderer deletes temporary files based on the output file stem.
remediation.suggestion: Create unique temporary files in a dedicated temporary directory and delete only files created during that run.

remediation.issue: Documentation references helper scripts that are not included.
remediation.suggestion: Add the referenced files or remove those workflow steps from the documentation.

content.value_statement: Creating useful demo music with code can require MIDI, soundfonts, rendering, and quality checks. This skill gives Claude, Codex, and Claude Code structured workflows for composing and exporting instrumental MP3 files.
actual_capabilities: Guides instrumental composition with Python, music21, MIDI, and General MIDI instruments.
Helps choose electronic or traditional rendering workflows by genre and instrument request.
Includes a renderer that converts JSON track structures into MP3 files.
Includes MIDI utilities for BPM, duration, drum extraction, and channel filtering.
Includes an audio validator for clipping, duration, silence, and volume changes.
Includes an installer for FluidSynth, FFmpeg, soundfonts, and Python packages.
limitations: It does not create vocals, lyrics, or real-time playback.
Audio quality depends on installed soundfonts and FluidSynth behavior.
The referenced midi_inventory.py and midi_transform.py files are not present in this package.
The installer changes system packages and should run only in a trusted environment.

use_cases.title: Prototype Game Music
use_cases.description: Create short instrumental loops for menus, levels, or prototypes without leaving the coding workflow.

use_cases.title: Draft Composition Ideas
use_cases.description: Turn a genre, tempo, and instrument idea into a rendered MP3 draft for review.

use_cases.title: Validate Generated Audio
use_cases.description: Check rendered files for clipping, silence, duration mismatch, and abrupt volume changes.

prompt_templates.title: Simple Instrumental Sketch
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner request for a short original track.
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a 30-second original piano and strings sketch in a calm mood. Render it as an MP3 and validate the audio.

prompt_templates.title: Choose The Right Pipeline
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a 45-second deep house instrumental loop at 124 BPM. Use the electronic workflow and explain the instrument choices.

prompt_templates.title: Arrange A Multi-Part Piece
prompt_templates.prompt: Compose a 90-second orchestral cue with intro, development, climax, and resolution. Balance strings, brass, woodwinds, and percussion.

prompt_templates.title: Render And Audit Audio
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced request focused on output quality.
prompt_templates.prompt: Create an instrumental reggae draft, render an MP3, validate clipping and duration, then revise the mix if validation warns.

output_examples.input: Create a short ambient electronic loop for a loading screen.
output_examples.output: A rendered MP3 with soft pads, sparse percussion, controlled volume, and a short validation summary.

output_examples.input: Make a 60-second chamber music draft with violin, cello, and piano.
output_examples.output: A traditional-pipeline MP3 draft with separate instrumental parts, MIDI program assignment, and quality checks.

output_examples.input: Check whether my generated MP3 clips or contains too much silence.
output_examples.output: A concise audio validation report that identifies clipping, duration issues, silence, and abrupt volume changes.

best_practices: Run the installer only in an isolated or trusted development environment.
Use explicit timing, velocities, and MIDI program assignments before rendering.
Validate every rendered MP3 before sharing or using it in a project.
anti_patterns: Do not use this skill to imitate protected songs, beats, riffs, or identifiable artists.
Do not assume referenced helper scripts exist without checking the package files.
Do not run the installer on a production machine without reviewing package changes.

faq.question: Does this skill create vocals or lyrics?
faq.answer: No. It is designed for instrumental music and MIDI-based rendering.

faq.question: Can it export MP3 files?
faq.answer: Yes. The included renderer converts supported music structures into MP3 files.

faq.question: Does it need system dependencies?
faq.answer: Yes. The workflow depends on FluidSynth, FFmpeg, soundfonts, and Python packages.

faq.question: Is it safe to run the installer automatically?
faq.answer: No. Review it first because it installs system and Python packages.

faq.question: Can it make electronic and orchestral music?
faq.answer: Yes. The documentation separates electronic and traditional workflows by genre and instrument needs.

faq.question: Can it analyze final audio quality?
faq.answer: Yes. The audio validator checks duration, clipping, silence, volume changes, and dynamic range.
